items: Which angel is entrusted with blowing the Trumpet?
Israfil will blow the Trumpet on the Day of Judgement.
By what name is the angel of death commonly known?
The Quran calls him 'the angel of death', commonly known as Azra'il.
Which angel is associated with rain and provision?
Mika'il is mentioned beside Jibril and is held to be in charge of rain and provision.
What are the two angels who question the dead in the grave called?
Munkar and Nakir question the deceased in the grave.
What are the two angels who record a person's deeds called?
The surah mentions noble recorders who know what you do.
Which of these is not one of the four major revealed books?
The Torah, Psalms, Gospel and Quran are scriptures; the Sunan are hadith collections.
What are the small scrolls revealed to Ibrahim called?
What do we call the sayings, actions and approvals of the Prophet?
The Sunnah is the Prophet's word, deed and tacit approval.
What is a person who met the Prophet as a believer and died as a believer called?
A companion met the Prophet while believing in him.
What is the generation that met the companions and learned from them called?
What is the gift the husband must give his wife at marriage called?
Mahr is the bride's right by the marriage contract.
In which surah is riba (interest) prohibited?
God has permitted trade and forbidden riba.
In which surah are intoxicants and gambling prohibited?
The verse calls intoxicants, gambling, idols and divining arrows an abomination of Satan.
In which surah is the eating of pork prohibited?
The verse forbids carrion, blood, pork and what is slaughtered for other than God.
In which surah are we commanded to be kind to parents and not say 'uff' to them?
'Do not say to them a word of disrespect.'
In which surah is backbiting forbidden, compared to eating the flesh of a dead brother?
In which surah are we told 'eat and drink but do not be excessive'?
The verse tells people to eat and drink without excess.
What does a Muslim say when beginning to eat?
Meals begin with the name of God.
What does a Muslim say after finishing a meal?
Subhanallah is tasbih; Alhamdulillah is tahmid; Allahu akbar is takbir.
What is saying 'La ilaha illallah' called?
Saying 'In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate' is the basmalah.
What is the Muslim greeting when meeting?
Muslims greet with 'peace be upon you'.
How is the greeting of peace answered?
One replies with a better greeting or the same.
What did the Prophet say about the neighbour?
One whose neighbour fears his harm cannot enter Paradise
Greeting a neighbour is not required
The Prophet said that one whose neighbour is unsafe from his harm will not enter Paradise.
What does the Quran say about those who unjustly eat an orphan's property?
They only fill their bellies with fire
'They consume only fire into their bellies.'
The tenth day of which month is Ashura?
Ashura is the tenth of Muharram, a day the Prophet fasted.
Which of these is one of the sacred months?
The sacred months are Dhul-Qa'dah, Dhul-Hijjah, Muharram and Rajab.
Which night is sought in the last ten nights of Ramadan?
Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.
What is the special prayer performed on the nights of Ramadan called?
Tarawih is the night prayer of Ramadan.
What does one say when seeking refuge before reciting the Quran?
'When you recite the Quran, seek refuge in God from the accursed Satan.'
What is the Prophet's ascent through the heavens from Al-Aqsa called?
Isra is the journey to Al-Aqsa; Mi'raj is the ascent to the heavens.
What is a rendering of the meaning of the Quran in another language called?
A translation conveys the meaning, not the miraculous wording.
What does one say when beginning wudu?
One begins wudu by mentioning God's name.
What did the Prophet recommend regarding purification on Friday?
Besides food and drink, what does a fasting person avoid?
Fasting includes giving up falsehood and idle speech.
Which prayer is performed before sunrise?
Fajr is prayed between dawn and sunrise.
How many rak'ahs are in the obligatory Isha prayer?
The Isha prayer has four rak'ahs.
How many times is Hajj obligatory in a lifetime for those able?
Hajj is obligatory once for those who are able.
What is the rate of zakat on gold, silver and trade goods?
On wealth that reaches the nisab, one-fortieth is due.
The sacrifice at Eid is a sunnah of which prophet?
Qurbani recalls Ibrahim's test and the ransom of his son.
In which surah are prayers described as prescribed at fixed times for the believers?
'Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers at specified times.'
What is the person who leads a congregational prayer called?
Which of these invalidates the prayer?
What is used in tayammum when there is no water?
Which angel is mentioned as the keeper of Paradise?
The reports name Ridwan as the keeper of Paradise.
